proposal: Reference LDO: LHV 42.9 MJ/kg, FAME 0 %, water 100 mg/kg, H/C per the test fuel analysis; corrections for the actual test fuel by agreed curves.
question: ALP-OWN-FUL-002 allows FAME (biodiesel) up to 7 % v/v and LHV 42.6-43.2 MJ/kg. PG-15/PG-16 refer to LHV 42.9 MJ/kg but not to FAME or water content, which affect output, heat rate and water injection. Please define the reference LDO for the guarantees.
response: Accepted as proposed; PG-15 and PG-16 conditions revised.
subject: Reference LDO for the LDO performance guarantees
